status: Prospective method amendment for an exploratory study on a previously examined scene. Frozen before computing or inspecting the new prior-top-K or multi-center outcomes; not a preregistered confirmatory experiment.
known_results: C32 selected by validation in prior revision. Corrected evaluation success 0.966484407 with 95% tile interval [0.949176892,0.981808474]. Prior accounting union saturated at 50% adoption for 32 and64 UEs. Prior manuscript and all prior quality/accounting results were available before this amendment.
geometry: Reuse parent geometry rows without alteration for distances1,2,5m and each split. No new locations, channels, noise or cohorts.

observations.rule: Independent Gaussian noise in dB, then nearest-even integer dB rounding. Each physical point has one fixed previous-role and one fixed current-role 64-beam observation shared across arms. No dynamic-range censoring, receiver sensitivity, or Rx beam sweep is simulated.

construction.T: Stable descending rank of all64 prior noisy/quantized beam powers, low beam-index tie. Choose firstK. Sort chosen beam IDs before current selection.
construction.L: Greedy nonmaximum suppression on stable descending prior measured rank: accept next beam if its minimum circular index distance from each accepted center is >=width. Stop after centers acceptances. Around each center include odd-width offsets -(width-1)/2 through +(width-1)/2, modulo64. These blocks are pairwise disjoint and cost exactly centers*width. The name denotes separated measured peaks, not identified physical multipath clusters. No current power constructs the candidates.
construction.C: Exactly parent contiguous construction: prior measured argmax center; for evenK<64 use offsets -(K/2-1)..+(K/2-1), plus stronger prior measured boundary at -K/2 or+K/2 (negative tie). C64 all beams.
construction.current_selection: Choose current noisy/quantized largest power among sorted candidate IDs, stable low-index tie.
construction.initialization: All families receive the same assumed prior full-bank measurement. Its one-time cost is outside the per-update ledger. Repeated endpoint trials do not establish that prior top-K is replenished over a trajectory.

quality.metric: current selected true beam power within3dB of current true best
quality.estimand: Within each distance and split, average success across eligible previous directions per distinct current location, then uniformly across current locations. This matches accounting uniform current then uniform previous.

bootstrap.interval: percentile95%; ratio of tile-summed current-location probabilities to tile-summed current counts

quality.scope: Conditional on one static scene and the declared current/prior population, not independent mobility trajectories or an external generalization guarantee.

selection.rule: Among all candidates whose validation95% tile-bootstrap lower endpoint is >=0.95, choose lowest measurement count. Break count ties by family topk, then lobes, then contiguous, then ASCII profile ID. Save baseline_selection.json before processing evaluation outcomes. No reselection after evaluation.
selection.evaluation_gate: Selected profile evaluation point success>=0.95; report full95% interval separately; evaluation lower bound is not selection or acceptance gate.

output_interface: tracking_validation.npz and tracking_results.npz preserve original geometry keys/order and expose group_<id>, selected_<id>, loss_db_<id>, within3db_<id>. baseline_selection.json written before test processing, qualified_baseline.json final. Legacy geometry and rankings retained; no old conventional arrays changed.
